confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on recent aggregated cost-of-living figures (Numbeo data via Expatica, dated June 2026, plus Housinganywhere and Cities Insider coffee and beer prices). Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: no aggregated Frankfurt bar price data was found, so cocktail (about 15 EUR) and wine (about 6.50 EUR per 0.2 L glass) are estimates from scattered single-venue menus and the local beer price relationship. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and Frankfurt's trade-fair-driven hotel demand, not checked against live listings; the 3-star anchor is the least certain. The FX observation could not be confirmed as the latest RBA figure. The most recent RBA value found is the 2026-03-20 observation, which is about eight months old, so the USD conversion basis may be stale. USD values assume roughly 1.15 USD per EUR. Prices are for a July 2026 window.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a large German city with international business and trade-fair demand, comparable to other major German metropolitan centres. Restaurant prices follow Frankfurt-specific aggregates. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate that reflects Frankfurt's higher hotel rates relative to other German cities.
